messages:
maya: Quick RFC follow-up — proposal to push coarse RBAC checks to the dashboard ingress (query gateway) and leave fine-grained enforcement in the executor. Intent: shave executor CPU and improve p95 for dashboards that crawl many panels.

sam: Makes sense at a high level. Can we enumerate failure modes? my concern is leakage with row-level perms.

maya: Failure modes I see: 1) stale ingest cache -> over-allow (executor still enforces, so limited blast). 2) ingress false-deny -> missing panel UX. 3) cache key explosion if we include many dynamic attrs.

lee: Hybrid suggestion: gateway performs tenant/role filtering and emits a permission-hash header. Executor validates the hash against row-level rules per-response. That keeps cheap rejects at edge but preserves correctness.

olivia: Important: the hash must be derived only from stable attributes (role, tenant). Do not include ephemeral inputs like session_id or ad-hoc filters.

sam: For caching, key= (query-signature, perm-hash, time-bucket). Otherwise cache will leak across roles.

maya: Example cache key: `panel_v1|qsig:SHA256(...)|perm:sha1(role:viewer,tenant:42)|t:60s`. TTL short for interactive dashboards.

olivia: What about panels where filters change per-widget (date ranges)? Gateway won't know those.

lee: Gateway only pre-filters on attributes independent of ad-hoc query. Any query-dependent filters are evaluated at executor. We can short-circuit common patterns (tenant in path).

maya: Tradeoffs: Pros — less executor CPU, better cache hit rate for similar-perm users, lower p95. Cons — more complexity, potential UX inconsistency, risk of high cache-key cardinality.

sam: Metrics to add: `auth.gateway.requests`, `auth.gateway.false_denies`, `panel.cache.hit_rate_by_perm`, `panel.exec.validation_latency`, `leakage_alert.cross_perm_hits`.

olivia: Add `missing_panel_rate` per-dashboard and surface top-10 affected dashboards in console.

lee: Rollout plan: 1) telemetry-only: gateway computes perm-hash and logs it. 2) pilot cache-key for a few internal dashboards. 3) enable prefilter for 5% users with auto-disable if `missing_panel_rate` > 1%. 4) ramp 5 -> 25 -> 100 with checks.

maya: Canary snippet (pseudo):
```
rbac:
  mode: telemetry | prefilter
  perm_attrs: [tenant_id, role]
  canary_pct: 5
  missing_panel_threshold: 0.01
  emit_headers: [x-rd-perm-v1]
```

deploy-bot: Canary template created at `infra/deploys/ingress/rbac-prefilter.yaml`. Telemetry dashboard scaffolded. :robot_face: 

sam: Perf knobs: TTL 30-120s for interactive panels. Add small LRU per ingress node mapping perm-hash -> deny to avoid repeated lookups.

olivia: Security: sign the permission-hash header with ingress key; executor should validate signature. Do not include raw perms in headers or logs in prod.

maya: Action items:
- lee: implement perm-hash generator & header contract (PR by EOD Wed).
- sam: dashboard telemetry + leakage alerts (dashboard PR).
- olivia: threat model + signing plan.
- maya: draft SRE runbook + rollback triggers.

lee: I'll version the header `x-rd-perm-v1` so we can evolve algorithm later.

sam: SGTM, I'll pair on metrics.

olivia: Scheduling 30m sync after PRs land to validate instrumentation.

maya: Thanks all — I'll post RFC follow-up with config and canary playbook. :thumbsup:
